actual_identity_obligations: Each connection needs an actual UnixStream and original peer pidfd, plus peer pid/boot_id/process_start_ticks/uid/actor binding.

Client constructors reject same real/effective UID and same PID. HostAuthorityPeerChannel/RootObservationStream verify the supplied original process identity against real socket credentials and pidfd lifetime.
The four connections are live public transport capabilities. Parent control messages may coordinate addresses and fixture metadata but do not authenticate a receipt or mint a channel capability.

Trainer Generator custody remains owned by the Trainer process. Material E/D signing keys, Source owner and ledger writer remain with Material. Each process loads its own real baseline; no cross-process Arc identity is asserted.

quotas.separate_trainer_incoming_limit: Trainer's own Semaphore4 is separate from Material's command admission. No limit, queue, stack, deadline or reconnect policy is increased.

failure_and_cancellation: Original command client exchange/readback slot consumption and unavailable semantics are unchanged.
Evidence client takes its original channel before asynchronous blocking work; cancellation or failed validation does not reconstitute a connection.
Material Source and evidence services do not attest new work; missing/pending/expired/error is not synthesized into completed evidence.
Socket worker termination and parent fixture cleanup must be observed under the existing common lifecycle limits. No successful startup or service completion is inferred from this static review.
remaining_work: Wire the four public sockets to actual separate 60001/60002 processes with original custody and exact peer records.
Retain Root's independently preheld trust/request/objective/model/owners/scope/plan contract and authenticate full original Source and freeze payloads at first admission.
Reconcile the final A/T/B overlay with the final frozen source map, registration and post-format byte guards.
